description: This file contains the implementation of a thread-safe, striped multi-producer, single-consumer buffer (StripedMpscBuffer) and its underlying ring buffer (MpscBoundedBuffer). It includes utility classes for bit operations and padding to optimize concurrency performance, and defines buffer status enums. The classes are designed for high concurrency scenarios, scaling linearly with the number of threads.

classes.name: StripedMpscBuffer
classes.description: A striped bounded buffer that uses multiple underlying ring buffers to scale writes with concurrency, employing thread ID hashing and retries.

classes.name: MpscBoundedBuffer
classes.description: A multi-producer, single-consumer ring buffer supporting concurrent add and drain operations, with capacity as a power of two for efficient indexing.

classes.name: BufferStatus
classes.description: An enum indicating the result of buffer operations such as success, full, empty, or contended.

classes.name: BitOps
classes.description: A static utility class providing bit manipulation functions, including power-of-two calculations and a 64-bit hash mixing function.

classes.name: Padding
classes.description: A static class defining cache line size constants for padding to prevent false sharing.

classes.name: PaddedHeadAndTail
classes.description: A struct with explicit layout used to pad the head and tail indices of the ring buffer to cache line boundaries.

methods.name: StripedMpscBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the array of underlying buffers.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of items across all underlying buffers.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the striped buffer.

methods.name: DrainTo
methods.description: Drains items from the striped buffer into an array or span.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add an item to the buffer, retrying with rehashed thread ID if contended.

methods.name: MpscBoundedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ring buffer with a capacity that is a power of two.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the ring buffer.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of items based on head and tail indices.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue an item, returning status indicating success or contention.

methods.name: TryTake
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an item, returning status indicating success or empty.

methods.name: DrainTo
methods.description: Drains items into a span or array segment.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer and head/tail indices.

methods.name: CeilingPowerOfTwo
methods.description: Calculates the smallest power of two greater than or equal to the input.

methods.name: Mix64
methods.description: Performs a 64-bit hash mixing operation for thread ID hashing.
